LanguageData.ResearchQueue_ConfirmDependentSnooze: Confirm snoozing when other projects depend on it

LanguageData.ResearchQueue_OpenNodeTip: Browse Node Research's tree. Research Queue still chooses what to research; the Research button brings you back here.

LanguageData.ResearchQueue_QueuedCardHint: Drag to change its place in the queue. Right-click for more options.
